text:
maria: Quick heads-up — seeing a spike of 503s from eu1 embeddings since ~02:12 UTC. Need a hotfix now. Requesting expedited deploy of image gcr.io/redwood/embeds:fix-timeout-20260322

devon: Is this the timeout tweak we discussed yesterday or a config drift?

maria: Binary change — reduced pool wait timeout. Plan: canary 10% for 5m -> 50% for 10m -> 100% in eu1 only. Rollback criteria: 503 rate > 0.5% sustained for 2m or p99 latency > 800ms. Release notes (short): https://go.redwood/release/embeds-20260322

simon: +1 from product. Ops to monitor dashboards and start pager if threshold hit. @ops-oncall?

ops-oncall: ops-oncall: standing by. I'll monitor embeddings.errors and embed-serve-eu p99. Pager on call: jordan. Ready for deploy when you trigger.

maria: tagging approvals — simon + devon approved. Devon, can you kick the deploybot when ready?

devon: kicking now. /deploybot start --service=embeds --region=eu1 --image=gcr.io/redwood/embeds:fix-timeout-20260322 --canary=10% --canary-window=5m

releasebot: releasebot: deploybot accepted the job. job_id=deploy-6140012345-1. Starting canary rollout to 10% (eu1).

devon: deploy logs: ```
Starting canary deploy (10%)
Healthchecks passing for 3/3 pods
No 5xx observed in first 90s
```

releasebot: releasebot: Canary green after 3m. Advancing to 50% per plan.

simon: simon: thanks. holding rollback lines open. If 503 >0.5% or p99 >800ms for two consecutive minutes, we rollback to gcr.io/redwood/embeds:stable-20260320.

maria: rollback command (ops): ```
# quick rollback via deploybot
/deploybot rollback --job deploy-6140012345-1 --to-image gcr.io/redwood/embeds:stable-20260320
# or kubectl fallback
kubectl set image deploy/embeds embeds=gcr.io/redwood/embeds:stable-20260320 -n eu1
```

ops-oncall: ops-oncall: monitoring live. Will escalate if anomalies. Assigned pager to jordan and set alert thresholds.

devon: Done — rollout reached 100% at 02:28 UTC. Observability shows error rate dropped to baseline. Pinning image in release config and adding small note to changelog.

maria: maria: great work — will notify support and close the expedited window. Will follow up with a brief postmortem tomorrow. :rocket:
